As the Israeli Prime Minister lands in Washington for his meeting with the US President, a bombshell news report has sparked fresh speculations about the ties between the two allies purportedly strained amid the Iran war.
According to Israel's Channel 12, Netanyahu struggled to secure a meeting with US President Donald Trump until Washington sent a clear message.
According to the Channel 12 report, the diplomatic channels told the Israeli government, and I quote,
If you believe you will arrive empty-handed, you will not be coming.
The stern message from Washington triggered a major climb-down from Netanyahu, forcing him to agree to a major progress in Gaza.
Following discussions with the Trump administration, Netanyahu reportedly convened an abrupt emergency cabinet meeting on Monday,
approving the entry of an international peacekeeping force in Gaza, despite Hamas still not disarming itself.
According to the Channel 12 report, Netanyahu and his officials planned to present what they claimed was new intelligence regarding Iran's military and nuclear activities.
However, the outlet failed to provide any details regarding the alleged intelligence.
Previous Israeli presentations to Trump regarding Iran's civilian nuclear program and allegations over violations of commitments have directly influenced US policy decisions, the media report added.
Netanyahu expressed confidence about his meeting with Trump.
I am on my way to Washington for a meeting with our friend, President Donald Trump.
This is my eighth meeting with him since he was elected president in his second term, more than with any other international leader.
It is a great privilege, but it is also a great responsibility.

I am setting out on this mission with one clear objective, to ensure the security, strength and future of our dear State of Israel.
